summary_short.zh: Video2x是一个基于机器学习的开源视频处理框架，专注于通过超分辨率和帧插值技术提升视频质量，让老旧或低清素材变得清晰流畅。它巧妙整合了多种神经网络模型（如Real-ESRGAN、RIFE），用户可根据内容类型选择最适合的算法——例如用Real-CUGAN处理动漫、用RIFE生成平滑慢动作。该工具提供命令行接口，支持本地处理视频文件，适合用于修复历史影像、增强动画细节或制作高质量慢镜头，开发者还可通过其模块化设计集成新模型来扩展功能。

summaries.en: Video2x is an open-source framework that enhances video quality through super-resolution and frame interpolation, making old or low-resolution footage look sharper and smoother. It achieves this by leveraging multiple neural network models like Real-ESRGAN and RIFE, allowing users to choose the best approach for their specific content. You can use it via command-line tools to upscale anime, restore archival videos, or create smoother slow-motion effects by processing video files directly on your computer.

summaries.zh: ai-data-science-team 是一个基于多智能体协作的AI项目，旨在自动化数据科学中的常规任务，如数据清洗和模型选择，以提升工作效率。其核心设计采用分工明确的AI代理，通过协同工作流处理数据预处理、特征工程等环节，体现了模块化智能体在复杂任务中的优势。实践上，用户可通过Python快速部署进行探索性数据分析或原型开发，并可调整代理配置以适应特定需求，为数据科学工作流提供灵活高效的自动化支持。
summaries.en: The ai-data-science-team project is an AI-powered multi-agent system that automates routine data science workflows, addressing the time-consuming nature of tasks like data cleaning and model selection. It employs specialized AI agents that collaborate through a structured workflow, with each agent handling specific steps such as data preprocessing or model training. Users can deploy it via Python to accelerate exploratory data analysis or prototyping, and customize the agent pipeline for tailored automation in their projects.
